title: Concept: a nuget.config that disables no inherited source
description: nuget.config declares a configuration that leaves every inherited source enabled, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a configuration that leaves every inherited source enabled.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a configuration that leaves every inherited source enabled.
